construction_auth_policy.username: Case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace removed; synthetic normalization
construction_auth_policy.account_view: Synthetic profile-scoped read-only balances; private original layout unobserved

construction_recovery_policy.request_username: Observed 6–50 ASCII letters/digits/dot/@/underscore/hyphen, starts alphanumeric, no whitespace
construction_recovery_policy.reset_password: Observed client: 8–24 characters, ASCII letter, digit and listed special character, no whitespace or angle brackets
construction_recovery_policy.delivery: Synthetic same episode mailbox, uniform request response
construction_recovery_policy.grant: Synthetic 15-minute one-use link; newer request invalidates prior link
construction_recovery_policy.reset: Revokes all sessions and reset grants for target account only

construction_registration_policy.source_sequence: Security code/email, verification, username availability, credentials, completion, login
construction_registration_policy.security_code: GMG1048 is synthetic; lookup uses hash
construction_registration_policy.mailbox: Only the fixture contact mailbox is supported; alternate addresses remain unimplemented
construction_registration_policy.grants: Synthetic 30-minute expiry. Pending/resend credential cannot verify; newer requests supersede prior links
construction_registration_policy.verification: Email possession required before username check or creation
construction_registration_policy.username: Observed 6–50 ASCII letters/digits/dot/@/underscore/hyphen, starts alphanumeric; local case-insensitive uniqueness rechecked at commit
construction_registration_policy.password: Same observed client requirements as password recovery

construction_guest_policy.lookup: Observed security-code and service-ZIP entry; synthetic exact fixture match, trimming outer whitespace
construction_guest_policy.grant: Separate HttpOnly browser capability, episode/account scoped, synthetic 25-minute expiry; failed lookup clears browser grant
construction_guest_policy.balance: Synthetic aggregate outstanding invoices for verified account only
construction_guest_policy.checkout: Local bank/card entry, review, authorization, idempotent commit and receipt; private original layout unobserved

payment_semantics.amount: Positive cents up to aggregate outstanding balance; no overpayment
payment_semantics.allocation: Synthetic oldest-due invoice first; fee assessed once
payment_semantics.settlement: Synthetic immediate posting; decline fixture ends 0002
payment_semantics.review: Synthetic 10-minute quote bound to guest capability, explicit review read and authorization, commit-time balance check
payment_semantics.instruments: Only masked instrument details and deterministic digest retained; never PAN/CVV/routing/account number
payment_semantics.receipt: Optional mock email; receipt remains available while guest grant is valid
